title: Hushai Counters Ahithophel

questions.question: What was Ahithophel's advice?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 17:1 (ESV): "...Let me choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue David tonight."

questions.question: Whose advice did Absalom prefer?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 17:14 (ESV): "And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, 'The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.'"

questions.question: What did Ahithophel do when his counsel was not followed?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 17:23 (ESV): "...he saddled his donkey and went off home... and set his house in order and hanged himself..."

questions.question: Where did Hushai say David and his men might be hiding?
options: In a pit or some other place
questions.correctAnswer: In a pit or some other place
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 17:9 (ESV): "Behold, even now he has hidden himself in one of the pits or in some other place."

questions.question: Who did Absalom set over the army instead of Joab?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 17:25 (ESV): "And Absalom set Amasa over the army in place of Joab."

questions.question: Hushai advised gathering all Israel from ______ to ______.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 17:11 (ESV): "...that all Israel be gathered to you, from Dan to Beersheba..."

questions.question: Where were Jonathan and Ahimaaz staying?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 17:17 (ESV): "Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were waiting at En-rogel."

questions.question: Where did the messengers hide from Absalom's servants?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 17:18-19 (ESV): "...and they went... to the house of a man at Bahurim, who had a well in his courtyard. And they went down into it."

questions.question: What did the woman spread over the well's mouth?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 17:19 (ESV): "And the woman took and spread a covering over the well's mouth and scattered grain on it..."

questions.question: Where did David go after crossing the Jordan?
Who brought provisions (beds, basins, pottery, wheat, etc.) to David at Mahanaim?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 17:27-29 (ESV): "...Shobi the son of Nahash... and Machir... and Barzillai the Gileadite... brought beds, basins..."

questions.question: Who was Amasa's father?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 17:25 (ESV): "...Now Amasa was the son of a man named Ithra the Ishmaelite..."

questions.question: Who was Amasa's mother?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 17:25 (ESV): "...who had married Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister of Zeruiah, Joab's mother."

questions.question: Why did the Lord defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel?
options: That the Lord might bring evil upon Absalom
questions.correctAnswer: That the Lord might bring evil upon Absalom
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 17:14 (ESV): "...For the LORD had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, so that the LORD might bring harm upon Absalom."

questions.question: Hushai compared David and his men to a bear robbed of her ______.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 17:8 (ESV): "...they are enraged, like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field."

key_verse_text: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.” For the LORD had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, so that the LORD might bring harm upon Absalom. (ESV)
